name: Catania
personality: Dignified perfectionist who values quality and seeks strong opponents.
story: A Cydonian who served a noble until she lost everything around 1444; by 1449 she is a mercenary keeping her dignity despite poverty. She joins automatically on Leda's route (as the recruitment tutorial per KeenGamer).

personalSkill.name: Punishing Squall
personalSkill.effect: Hit+20 when Attack Speed >= foe's AS+3. Lv20: Wind My Friend (Atk+3 when AS >= foe's AS+5); Lv35: Wind My Friend+ (adds Avo+20 when AS >= foe's AS+8).

why: Joins Leda's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Second Physic healer (spear Guardian) and the army's only flier
path: Bishop (Part II side trip: doubled Physic, Barrier)
build.part1Target: Guardian (Wing Soldier stays certified for flier maps)
build.notes: She is the only Physic plus Warp unit. Wing Soldier (Ch 6 to 9) flies and masters Protecting Wings while the Arena trains White B and Spear B. Guardian at Lv 35 (Ch 10). Part II Ch 3 to 4 is a Bishop stint: doubled Physic for Ch 3 and Barrier.

guide.role: Second healer, the only flier, Res wall
guide.summary: Second Physic user and the army's only flier. Wing Soldier until Lv 35 (Ch 6 to 9), then Guardian: a spear front-liner with Physic, Magic Heal +10 and Res 50 growth who walls the mage side. Switch back to Wing Soldier for free when a map needs wings.
guide.playstyle: Hold the second line on the mage side and Physic whoever is cut off. Strike only foes she outspeeds by 3 (Punishing Squall Hit +20) or 5 (Wind My Friend Atk +3). While flying, dismount or pull back when the danger line shows an archer.
keys: Ornius Rider in Ch 5, Wing Soldier at Lv 20 (Ch 6): the army's only wings
Arena Mage Training on alternate weeks from Ch 6 for White B; Mounted for Spear B
Guardian the day she shows Lv 35 with Spear B (Ch 10, Ch 11 at worst)
Learn Physic (White B) before the Ch 11 battle; Seraphim (White C) for the undead
Keep Wing Soldier certified: fly the Part II Ch 2 Ranger for Cleansing Blade +1
watch: Bows: 3x damage on fliers. Dismount when the danger line shows an archer
Weight as Wing Soldier: Wooden Spear +5 5 + Phantom Ring 3 = 8. Drop the ring if AS +5 stops
Weight as Sentinel: Iron Spear +4 7 + Healing Staff 3 = 10, no Spd from the spear. Wind My Friend+ AS +8 needs Quick Thrust
Heals: Wing Soldier can't cast White Magic, so she heals only as Guardian or Bishop
Mount: no pegasus on Leda's route, so Wing Soldier runs base rates (Spd +0)

routeNotes.note: Her only partner here is Lysander (filler, 3S 7R). Seat Leda + Lysander + Catania: his recruit meals build their pair too.
From Ch 10 she and Olympia both carry Physic: Olympia covers the back line, Catania walks or flies to the unit that's cut off.
Guardian comes from Dietrich's run: no unlock on this route, just an Advanced License at Lv 35 with Spear B.

path: Wing Soldier (joins at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class)
copies.role: Flier, spear and sword speed skirmisher
copies.why: Changed from Myrmidon. Dietrich's army has no fliers, and Part II wants 2 to 3 (Ch 2 asks for fliers to catch a fleeing Ranger before Turn 4). Dragoon isn't unlocked on this path, so Wing Soldier is the only flier she can take. The video rates her B as a Wing Soldier. Trade-off: home Catania is also a Wing Soldier, so the Part III merge gains less; the different-class rule was our own habit, not a game rule.
